uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4068-7795.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

443-1263-2438-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

262-2433-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, creating at least one creature token.
When the token enters, Rosie triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Devoted Druid.
Activate Devoted Druid by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
262-2433-4762.notes: If Devoted Druid starts with power 2 or greater, you'll make more tokens each loop and can place +1/+1 counters on other creatures after placing the first.

1636-5371-7329-7629.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
1636-5371-7329-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-5371-7329-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

3967-4871-5220-5447.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
3967-4871-5220-5447.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2781-3817-5147.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

967-2557-3809-5256-7087.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5402-5705.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

671-2173-2438-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Carrion Feeder enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1456-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

586-3497-5258-5618-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

632-2034-2079-3621-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-2079-3621-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

1429-5226-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-5226-5402-5929.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

856-1808-2292-4231.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4642-6175.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4642-6175.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Territorial Scythecat trigger.
Resolve the Territorial Scythecat trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

656-2232-5705-5706.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Ugin's Conjurant spell.
When Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Mysterious Egg from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Mysterious Egg by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Mysterious Egg spell.
When Mysterious Egg enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ugin's Conjurant from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2248-4543-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Skyshroud Ranger exiled with brain counters on them.
2248-4543-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Skyshroud Ranger's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Rex using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Rex.
Repeat.

508-1656-3866-4283.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional creatures.
It is your upkeep.
508-1656-3866-4283.description:
During your upkeep, activate Necrotic Ooze using Whisper's ability by tapping it and sacrificing two other creatures, returning Abhorrent Overlord from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abhorrent Overlord enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Harpy creature tokens.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Black Carriage's ability by sacrificing Abhorrent Overlord, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.

1367-4899.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 1 until you have an empty library.
Resolve the first Phyrexian Devourer ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it.
If Phyrexian Devourer's power is at least seven, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle it into your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Nexus of Fate from your library.
Repeat from step 6.

380-719-2232-2743.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
When the Biovisionary token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the nontoken Biovisionary to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Repeat steps 1 though 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger from the Biovisionary token, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

851-1132-1594-3263-4761.description:
Cast Teferi by paying {W}{U}.
Widespread Thieving triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2607-2682-4705.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least three.
2607-2682-4705.description:
Cast Dire Fleet Ravager by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Dire Fleet Ravager trigger, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
Resolve the second Dire Fleet Ravager trigger, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1263-2842-3479-4050.notablePrerequisites: You attacked with a creature this turn.
1263-2842-3479-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
Life Insurance and Blood Artist triggers.
Resolve the Life Insurance trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing target player to lose 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Activate Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1414-2055-2713.description:
Tap Lotus Petal, sacrificing it to add {W}.
Pay {W} to Auriok Salvager, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Lotus Petal.
Repeat.
